No production data or real operational key custody
No new OCI execution or private-host qualification

mathematical_lenses.continuum: not_applicable: discrete ledger revisions and exact byte identities

mathematical_lenses.n_ality: applied: distinguish segment identity, revision, history scope, alerts and authority
mathematical_lenses.simplex: not_applicable: exact integrity and authorization decisions

Run exact published producer and Studio CI without changing gates
Implement single-writer transition with restart/recovery evidence
Qualify independent Titan key and latest-anchor custody
